headlines.title: Democratic socialist will face Republican rival in Florida after Senate primary upset
headlines.description: NBC News projects that Nixon, a state lawmaker, will face GOP Sen. Ashley Moody, who was appointed to replace Secretary of State Marco Rubio, in the general election.

headlines.title: GOP Sen. Dan Sullivan and Democrat Mary Peltola advance to battleground Senate election in Alaska
headlines.description: NBC News projects that Sullivan and Peltola will advance to the general election, but it’s not clear whether Sullivan will also face an opponent with the same name.

headlines.title: Republican Byron Donalds and Democrat David Jolly set to square off for Florida’s governorship
headlines.description: Donalds and Jolly easily won their primaries, NBC News projects, as Donalds enters the general election with a big financial advantage.

headlines.title: Merck and Moderna say cancer vaccine shows promise in preventing recurrence of melanoma
headlines.description: Pharmaceutical giants Moderna and Merck said that an experimental vaccine treatment has shown signs of preventing skin cancer from returning or spreading in a study of melanoma patients.

headlines.title: Trump says he had 'a good conversation' with Canadian prime minister about tariffs
headlines.description: President Trump told reporters he had "a good conversation" with Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney about his administration's planned tariffs. The president also discussed his decision to delay implementing the tariffs for a few days as the countries come to a potential trade deal.

headlines.title: U.S. military drills with South Korea are cut short after surprise order
headlines.description: The annual U.S.-South Korea drills, known as Ulchi Freedom Shield, will end Aug. 21 rather than Aug. 27 as originally scheduled, both countries said.

headlines.title: Unitree unveils ‘Superman’ humanoid robot
headlines.description: Chinese robotics company Unitree unveiled a new humanoid robot dubbed “Superman” which it says is “breaking the limits of humanity.” According to the company, the robot can perform a vertical jump of over 6 feet and can reach a top speed of more than 40 feet per second.

headlines.title: Hayden Panettiere’s Estranged Mother Shares First Comments
headlines.description: A heavily redacted incident report on Hayden Panettiere’s death states both her on-again, off-again boyfriend Brian Hickerson and his brother Zach were present when police arrived on scene. Meanwhile, Panettiere’s mother Lesley Vogel is speaking out for the first time, telling NBC exclusively in a phone interview, “Hayden sadly lost her way and I wish it were different. headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: 4 Americans killed in helicopter crash in Kenya
headlines.description: Four Americans are dead following a helicopter crash in a remote area of northern Kenya, the U.S.

headlines.title: Two tons of squid spill out onto Rhode Island roadway
headlines.description: A tractor-trailer tipped over and spilled two tons of squid onto a Rhode Island roadway, prompting an hours-long cleanup of what local police dubbed the “Squidpocalypse of ‘26,” officials said Wednesday.

headlines.title: Bond yields plunge after Treasury announces surprise move to ease rising rates
